capabilities: Draw a life-in-weeks grid of circles
Create and open a note per week or day
Store each note's circle in a frontmatter property
Generate notes from templates with date placeholders
Attach photos from the vault or an Immich server
extras: Optional Immich picker is off by default; the API key is stored in plain text in data.json, and the exported configuration code includes it. Settings can be exported and imported as a base64 code or fetched from a URL. Interface available in English, Ukrainian and Polish; documentation site at week.dth.ink.
problem: Weekly journaling in Obsidian has no visual overview of a whole life of weeks, so it is hard to see which weeks are written and what kind of week each one was.

relations.evidence: If you run your own Immich photo server, the "Create week file" dialog can show that week's photos

summary: Life-in-weeks grid journal that draws one colored circle per week or day of your life, each linked to a Markdown note.
